theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiRH_measure_eq_of_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ σ : Measure (Rn N)), (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) → μ ≪ σ → (∀ᵐ x ∂σ, Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μ (Metric.closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1))) ∧ Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ σ (Metric.closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)))) → μ = σ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
